name: Publer
description: Publer is a social media management platform for workspaces, accounts, scheduling, publishing, media, analytics, and collaboration.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned least-privilege Publer API key and bind it to one exact workspace, then let agents inspect bounded identity-redacted workspace references and account provider/type structure.

credentialRequirements.name: PUBLER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Publer API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated key with only workspaces and accounts scopes in Settings > Access & Login > API Keys. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as Bearer-API to https://app.publer.com.

credentialRequirements.name: PUBLER_WORKSPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Publer workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Paste one exact workspace ID returned by the official List Workspaces endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read workspace and account structure
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity-redacted workspace references and account provider/type structure for one exact Publer workspace.

approvalRequired.label: List Publer workspace references
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five workspace IDs without names, pictures, owners, members, plans, or other identity.

approvalRequired.label: List Publer account structure
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five account IDs, providers, and account types for one exact workspace without names, social IDs, pictures, profile identity, or content.

blocked.label: Access private identity or members
blocked.description: Workspace/account names and pictures, owners, members, emails, social IDs, handles, profile identity, roles, and plans are outside Relay's bounded connector.

blocked.label: Access posts, media, or analytics
blocked.description: Posts, drafts, schedules, media, comments, insights, charts, hashtags, best times, member performance, competitors, and other content or analytics remain blocked.

blocked.label: Publish or administer Publer
blocked.description: Creating, scheduling, publishing, editing, deleting, uploading, connecting accounts, changing workspaces, members, roles, keys, billing, or administration remains blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, methods, queries, bodies, job polling, pagination, bulk operations, exports, browser sessions, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded identity-redacted reads require approval; all identity, members, content, media, analytics, publishing, writes, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two bounded reads run directly; exact workspace binding, fixed GET paths, identity redaction, response caps, audits, and Publer's rate limit remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives two bounded Publer read tools with exact workspace binding and identity/content redaction.
Hermes receives the same two bounded Publer read tools with exact workspace binding and identity/content redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Publer public API access requires an eligible Business or Enterprise account, a customer-created least-privilege key with workspaces/accounts scopes, and one exact workspace ID.
providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a dedicated key in Settings > Access & Login > API Keys, selects only workspaces and accounts, supplies one exact workspace ID, and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Publer documents its public REST API, fixed https://app.publer.com/api/v1 base, Bearer-API authentication, eligible Business/Enterprise access, and 100 requests per two minutes per user.
Customers create scoped API keys, use Authorization: Bearer-API, and provide Publer-Workspace-Id for workspace-bound requests; workspaces and accounts are documented least-privilege scopes.
Official reference documents GET /workspaces and the workspace ID used as context for other API endpoints.
Official reference documents GET /accounts with required Publer-Workspace-Id and account ID, provider, type, name, social ID and picture fields; Relay returns only ID/provider/type.
Publer documents a fixed-window limit of 100 requests per two minutes per user and HTTP 429 when exceeded.

securityNotes: The customer key is encrypted as a secret reference and is sent only as Bearer-API to the fixed https://app.publer.com origin.
Customers must create a dedicated key with only workspaces and accounts scopes; posts and media scopes are neither requested nor accepted by this connector.
Every account request is bound server-side to the stored exact workspace ID; tools accept no alternate workspace IDs, paths, methods, queries, or bodies.
Responses are capped at 1 MB and twenty-five items; redirects, arbitrary pagination, raw responses, job polling, bulk operations, and exports are blocked.
Workspace/account names and pictures, owners, members, emails, plans, social IDs, handles, profile identity, posts, media, analytics, publishing, and administration are excluded.
Relay enforces Publer's documented ceiling of one hundred requests per two minutes per user.
